mapper.sql: icam03_fund_id AS fund_id, icam03_std_date AS std_date, icam03_fund_cd AS fund_cd, icam03_fund_nm AS fund_nm, icam03_kofia_fund_cd AS kofia_fund_cd, icam03_ksd_fund_cd AS ksd_fund_cd, icam03_ksd_item_cd AS ksd_item_cd, icam03_trust_nm AS trust_nm, icam03_fund_type_nm AS fund_type_nm, icam03_public_nm AS public_nm, icam03_parent_nm AS parent_nm, icam03_class_type_nm AS class_type_nm, icam03_fund_unit_nm AS fund_unit_nm, icam03_char_class_nm AS char_class_nm, icam03_diff_div_yn AS diff_div_yn, icam03_set_date AS set_date, icam03_end_date AS end_date, icam03_end_expect_date AS end_expect_date, icam03_operator1 AS operator1, icam03_operator2 AS operator2, icam03_consignment_nm AS consignment_nm, icam03_trust_bank_nm AS trust_bank_nm, icam03_office_work_nm AS office_work_nm, icam03_cur AS cur, icam03_close_date AS close_date, icam03_fee_date AS fee_date, icam03_management_rate AS management_rate, icam03_sales_rate AS sales_rate, icam03_consignment_rate AS consignment_rate, icam03_office_work_rate AS office_work_rate, icam03_set_amt AS set_amt, icam03_nav AS nav, icam03_work_date_string AS work_date_string, icam03_worker AS worker
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT icam03_fund.* , f_cdnm('IcamTrustCode' , icam03_trust_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_trust_nm , f_cdnm('IcamFundType' , icam03_fund_type_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_fund_type_nm , f_cdnm('IcamPublicCode' , icam03_public_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_public_nm , f_cdnm('IcamParentCode' , icam03_parent_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_parent_nm , f_cdnm('IcamClassType' , icam03_class_type_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_class_type_nm , f_cdnm('IcamFundUnitCode' , icam03_fund_unit_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_fund_unit_nm , f_cdnm('IcamCharClassCode', icam03_char_class_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_char_class_nm , to_char(icam03_work_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') as icam03_work_date_string FROM icam03_fund , sys01_company WHERE icam03_icam_company_cd = sys01_icam_company_cd AND sys01_company_id = #{companyId} AND (icam03_fund_cd, icam03_std_date) IN ( SELECT icam03_fund_cd, MAX(icam03_std_date) FROM icam03_fund a WHERE a.icam03_icam_company_cd = icam03_icam_company_cd GROUP BY icam03_fund_cd ) ) t ORDER BY fund_cd

SELECT FROM ( SELECT icam03_fund.* , f_cdnm('IcamTrustCode' , icam03_trust_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_trust_nm , f_cdnm('IcamFundType' , icam03_fund_type_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_fund_type_nm , f_cdnm('IcamPublicCode' , icam03_public_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_public_nm , f_cdnm('IcamParentCode' , icam03_parent_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_parent_nm , f_cdnm('IcamClassType' , icam03_class_type_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_class_type_nm , f_cdnm('IcamFundUnitCode' , icam03_fund_unit_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_fund_unit_nm , f_cdnm('IcamCharClassCode', icam03_char_class_cd , sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) as icam03_char_class_nm , to_char(icam03_work_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') as icam03_work_date_string FROM icam03_fund INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_icam_company_cd = icam03_icam_company_cd WHERE sys01_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND icam03_fund_cd = #{p.fundCode} ORDER BY icam03_std_date DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset} ) t ORDER BY std_date DESC
